usage: tarx [-cvxz] [-C dir] [-f archive] [-b blocksize] file ...
       tarx -t [-v] [-f archive]

  -c   create a new archive
  -x   extract files
  -v   verbose
  -z   filter through gzip
  -t   list contents
  -C dir        change to dir before doing anything
  -f archive    read or write the archive at this path
  -b blocksize  block size in 512-byte records
